audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all seven Sam house records: both Crispy Bass dinners, the band-genre choice, the dropped snack, Kent’s popcorn trauma scene, and both romantic follow-up branches. Every line, player thought, embedded question, response choice, conditional and gender branch, food and music term, trauma meaning, and family voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Sam, Sebastian, Jodi, Kent, Crispy Bass, Pelican Town music, and farm terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and prior-choice conditions, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
